# Test cross-entropy method convergence (from test_q2_cross_entropy_optimize.py)
def test_one_timestep_reward():
    """Test that CE method converges to optimal action when only one action gives reward"""
    env = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=1, goal_y=0, goal_radius=0.1)
    num_actions = len(PointEnv.action_map)
    horizon = 1
    optimizer = CrossEntropyMethod(env, horizon)
    
    # Initialize probs to be uniform
    optimizer.probs = np.ones(shape=(horizon, num_actions)) / num_actions
    # Run CE method with many samples
    optimizer.optimize(num_samples=1000, num_elites=10, iterations=1)
    # Check that updated probs are deterministic on the best action (action 1)
    expected = np.array([0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    return np.allclose(optimizer.probs[0], expected, atol=0.1)

def test_evaluate_plans_unique():
    """Test from test_q3_evaluate_plans.py"""
    env = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=2, goal_y=0, goal_radius=1)
    plans = np.array([
        [0, 0],  # Stay at origin twice
        [0, 1],  # Stay, then move right
        [1, 1],  # Move right twice 
    ])
    true_rewards = np.array([0, 1, 2])
    calculated_rewards = env.evaluate_plans_memoized(plans)
    return np.allclose(true_rewards, calculated_rewards)

def test_evaluate_plans_shared_subplans():
    """Test caching with shared subplans"""
    env = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=2, goal_y=0, goal_radius=1)
    plans = np.array([
        [1, 1, 1, 1],
        [1, 1, 1, 3], 
        [1, 1, 3, 1],
        [1, 3, 1, 1],
    ])
    true_rewards = np.array([3, 3, 3, 2])
    calculated_rewards = env.evaluate_plans_memoized(plans)
    return np.allclose(true_rewards, calculated_rewards)

print("Running more comprehensive tests...")
print("✓ test_one_timestep_reward:", test_one_timestep_reward())
print("✓ test_evaluate_plans_unique:", test_evaluate_plans_unique())
print("✓ test_evaluate_plans_shared_subplans:", test_evaluate_plans_shared_subplans())
